headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty snapped two-day rally as IT stocks faced selling pressure

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 30 November.

why: IT stocks faced intense selling pressure dragging benchmark indices down.
Profit-booking emerged following a brief two-day market recovery.
Brent crude oil prices rose above $97 per barrel, weighing on market sentiment.
Investors locked in gains after a strong 15% market rally over the prior four weeks.
whatHappening: On the last trading session, Sensex tumbled nearly 1,000 points while Nifty dropped below 25,650.
IT stocks led the market sell-off, while metal stocks outperformed during early trade.
Global equities saw the S&P 500 post its best week since April 2025 driven by an AI tech rally.
Bisleri faced scrutiny in West Bengal after water samples tested positive for coliform bacteria.
summary: On the last trading day, Indian benchmark indices snapped a two-day rally as Sensex tumbled nearly 1,000 points and Nifty fell below 25,650. Heavy selling pressure in IT stocks and rising Brent crude oil prices contributed to the broad market sell-off. The stock market is closed today for the weekend and will reopen for trading on Monday, 30 November.
